members.name: Xalpheric
members.bio: Jason Belcher — Birmingham-based electronic producer and co-founder of MIDI Mob Collective. Koala sampler, hardware drum machines, and groove-driven electronic music spanning lofi, jazz-hop, ambient, and experimental.

members.name: Gone
members.bio: Josh Davis creates immersive soundscapes blending folk sensibilities with electronic textures and ambient atmospheres.

members.name: Future Primitives
members.bio: Live performance ensemble delivering raw, visceral sonic experiences. Featured performing "Black Iron Prison" on Little Room In Florida.

members.name: Lower Hybrid
members.role: Synth Pop · Electro Punk · Post Rock
members.bio: Shane and Kaleb Wynn — synth pop, electro punk and post rock through a lo-fi DIY lens. Analog hardware synths and drum machines create a grimy, yet psychedelic garage aesthetic. From Birmingham, Alabama.

members.name: Carbilicon
members.bio: Noah Richardson — Korg hardware enthusiast and vinyl DJ specializing in classic Goa trance. Known for hypnotic live performances and deep hardware explorations.

members.name: Joseph Deese / Hamrock Records
members.bio: Birmingham producer creating instrumental music focused on mental wellness and relaxation. Prolific creator with a digital recording studio and a mission to support mental health through sound.
